name: Emerging Technologies for Digital Transformation
description: This course introduces MBA students to the major emerging technologies that are reshaping industries, organizational design, managerial work, customer experience, and competitive strategy. The course is not a technical coding course. Instead, it equips students to understand what these technologies are, how they create business value, what risks and governance challenges they introduce, and how managers should evaluate, adopt, and scale them responsibly.
